seed.description: Synthetic regression: retain only the final 600 code units for long raw snippets and drop omission metadata. This is not a claim of a historical production defect.

fix.scope: Restore the unmodified pinned native parser, not a stub.

scope: The actual parseToolArguments module boundary. No dispatcher or agent-loop claim.

priorInspection.reservedMeaning: A newly authored behavioral holdout fixed before candidate tuning, not a claim of unseen source.
priorInspection.knownInspection: The family fixture, pinned native parser, task loader, and qualification runner were inspected. A native counterexample confirmed that a different omission marker preserves the supported contract. No candidate prompts or campaign results were read.
priorInspection.distinction: Keep bounded raw evidence in refused tool arguments without truncating valid input.

grading.contract: Grade bounded raw-prefix evidence, refusal, failure categories, and complete successful values without requiring an omission marker or count format.
grading.alternativeControl: The second valid repair uses a different omission marker to prevent format-only false negatives.
